points.quote: and the layers above see none of it
points.problem: The caption of Fig 8.2 appeals to 'the layers above', but layers are not introduced until section 06. Here a newcomer has no referent.
points.hint: Say 'and the programs above see none of it', or drop the clause.

points.problem: The unlabelled vertical tick marks on the NRZ trace and the unlabelled digit rows under each waveform are never named. Nothing on the picture or in the caption says the ticks are the receiver's sampling instants or that the rows are what it read, so the five-zeros claim has to be inferred. Fig 8.5 labels its row 'read'.
points.hint: Label the tick marks 'receiver samples' and the digit rows 'read'.
